title: Pump + Filter + Fountain
goal: Choose and install a low-maintenance circulation and filtration setup with enough capacity for possible small fish later.

phaseEstimate.note: Current project allowance includes the $30 Smartpond already purchased. Final cost depends on which system option is selected.

ownedEquipment.item: Smartpond Filter Kit with Pump from Lowe's
ownedEquipment.note: Already purchased. It can be used in Option A or kept as nursery/backup equipment if Option B is selected.

systemOptions.label: Option A — Keep the Smartpond
systemOptions.summary: Use the Smartpond as the visible fountain and add a separate pump and permanent mechanical/biological filter.
systemOptions.maintenance: Higher than Option B because there are two pumps/fountain components to maintain.

items.item: Adjustable main pond pump, approximately 300–500 GPH
Tubing, flow control and quiet return fittings

systemOptions.label: Option B — One Integrated System
systemOptions.summary: Do not use the Smartpond in the permanent pond. Use one proper pump/filter system with a gentle fountain or return attachment.
systemOptions.maintenance: Lower-maintenance option with fewer pumps, fittings and failure points.
systemOptions.qualityNote: Best fit for the goal of simpler maintenance and consistent filtration, provided the integrated system has proper mechanical and biological filtration.
systemOptions.accountingNote: The $30 already spent on the Smartpond remains part of project actual spend even if it is not used in the permanent pond.

items.role: Single main circulation and filtration system

decisionNote: No option is selected yet. Option B is expected to require less maintenance; final selection will be made later.

items.item: Smartpond Filter Kit with Pump from Lowe's
items.note: Only committed Phase 3 purchase so far. Remaining purchases depend on Option A vs Option B.

completionMemory.title: End of Phase 3
completionMemory.caption: Permanent circulation, filtration and fountain system installed and running.
